hints.title: Depth and Subtree Tuple Recursion
hints.text: From each node, collect both the maximum depth of its subtrees and the lowest common ancestor of the deepest leaves.

hints.title: Equal Depth Convergence
hints.text: If left and right child subtrees reach identical maximum depths, the current node is the lowest common ancestor for those deepest leaves.

hints.title: Asymmetric Subtree Propagation
hints.text: When one child subtree is strictly deeper than the other, propagate the candidate ancestor from the deeper side upward with depth incremented by one.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Post-order DFS computing subtree depths and ancestors simultaneously.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate passes to determine deepest leaves followed by repeated ancestor queries take O(N^2) time on unbalanced trees.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Call stack scales with tree height H.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Return pair of (depth, ancestor) in a single recursive post-order traversal.
